cli.sessions_move_workset.warning_sends.role: CLI/TUI heading line of the move confirmation (shown before the user approves moving a conversation to another device)
cli.sessions_move_workset.warning_sends.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm
cli.sessions_move_workset.warning_sends.note: {session} is a conversation id (hex), {device} a device name; keep both verbatim. 'working files' = the git worktrees and uncommitted/unpushed work the conversation used. 'mid-conversation' = while the conversation is still going.

cli.sessions_move_workset.warning_stays.role: CLI/TUI heading line of the move confirmation when this version cannot transfer the files
cli.sessions_move_workset.warning_stays.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm
cli.sessions_move_workset.warning_stays.note: {session} conversation id, {device} device name: keep verbatim. Must say clearly that the files do NOT travel and remain on the current device. {source} is the name of the device that keeps the working files (the conversation's current owner), verbatim; it is NOT necessarily the device the user is typing on.

cli.sessions_move_workset.brings_summary.role: one summary line of counts under the warning
cli.sessions_move_workset.brings_summary.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm
cli.sessions_move_workset.brings_summary.note: ICU plurals: keep the three plural blocks and '#'. {size} is an already formatted byte size like '3.2 MB'. The middle dots are separators; keep them.

cli.sessions_move_workset.worktree_line.role: one indented line per git worktree
cli.sessions_move_workset.worktree_line.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm
cli.sessions_move_workset.worktree_line.note: {path} is a ~/ path, {branch} a git branch name: verbatim. The four numbers are counts of unpushed commits and staged/unstaged/untracked files; 'staged', 'unstaged', 'untracked' are git states: translate idiomatically or keep the git term the locale uses.

cli.sessions_move_workset.worktree_left.role: one indented line per worktree that does not travel
cli.sessions_move_workset.worktree_left.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm
cli.sessions_move_workset.worktree_left.note: {path} verbatim; {reason} is one of the reason.* phrases (lower-case clause).

cli.sessions_move_workset.withheld_secre.role: list line: a file excluded because it looks like a credential
cli.sessions_move_workset.withheld_secre.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm

cli.sessions_move_workset.withheld_histo.role: list line: a worktree withheld because its unpushed commits look like they contain a credential
cli.sessions_move_workset.withheld_histo.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm

cli.sessions_move_workset.leaves_behind.role: list line: a dependency folder that is never copied
cli.sessions_move_workset.leaves_behind.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm
cli.sessions_move_workset.leaves_behind.note: {path} verbatim (e.g. node_modules); {command} is a shell command, verbatim.

cli.sessions_move_workset.advice_sends.role: closing advice before the yes/no prompt
cli.sessions_move_workset.advice_sends.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm

cli.sessions_move_workset.advice_stays.role: closing advice before the yes/no prompt (files stay here)
cli.sessions_move_workset.advice_stays.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm
cli.sessions_move_workset.advice_stays.note: {device} device name verbatim. {source} is the name of the device that keeps the working files (the conversation's current owner), verbatim; it is NOT necessarily the device the user is typing on.

cli.sessions_move_workset.prompt_sends.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm
cli.sessions_move_workset.prompt_sends.note: Keep '[y/N] ' exactly, including the trailing space: the user types y.

cli.sessions_move_workset.prompt_stays.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm
cli.sessions_move_workset.prompt_stays.note: Keep '[y/N] ' exactly, including the trailing space. {source} is the name of the device that keeps the working files (the conversation's current owner), verbatim; it is NOT necessarily the device the user is typing on.

cli.sessions_move_workset.aborted.role: CLI result after the user declined
cli.sessions_move_workset.aborted.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm

cli.sessions_move_workset.needs_confirma.role: CLI error when a script moved a conversation with working files without confirming
cli.sessions_move_workset.needs_confirma.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm
cli.sessions_move_workset.needs_confirma.note: Keep --dry-run, --confirm-working-set, --yes, --without-working-set verbatim; {digest} is a sha256: token, verbatim. {source} is the name of the device that keeps the working files (the conversation's current owner), verbatim; it is NOT necessarily the device the user is typing on.

cli.sessions_move_workset.changed.role: CLI notice: the list changed between showing and confirming
cli.sessions_move_workset.changed.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm

cli.sessions_move_workset.unknown.role: CLI error: the git state could not be read, so the move was refused
cli.sessions_move_workset.unknown.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm
cli.sessions_move_workset.unknown.note: {step} is a machine word (e.g. status), {repo} a ~/ path: verbatim. Keep --without-working-set verbatim. {source} is the name of the device that keeps the working files (the conversation's current owner), verbatim; it is NOT necessarily the device the user is typing on.

cli.sessions_move_workset.unsupported.role: CLI error: the other device is too old
cli.sessions_move_workset.unsupported.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm

cli.sessions_move_workset.none.role: CLI --dry-run result when there is nothing to confirm
cli.sessions_move_workset.none.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm

cli.sessions_move_workset.receipt_not_tr.role: CLI line after a confirmed move: what did not travel
cli.sessions_move_workset.receipt_not_tr.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm
cli.sessions_move_workset.receipt_not_tr.note: ICU plural on {count}; {device} is the device the files stayed on.

cli.sessions_move_workset.receipt_withou.role: CLI line after a move with --without-working-set
cli.sessions_move_workset.receipt_withou.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm

cli.sessions_move_workset.receipt_keep.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm
cli.sessions_move_workset.receipt_keep.note: {device} = where the copy now is; verbatim. {source} is the name of the device that keeps the working files (the conversation's current owner), verbatim; it is NOT necessarily the device the user is typing on.

cli.sessions_move_workset.help_dry_run.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm
cli.sessions_move_workset.help_dry_run.note: lower-case start, no final period (argparse help style).

cli.sessions_move_workset.help_confirm.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm
cli.sessions_move_workset.help_confirm.note: Keep --dry-run and working_set.scope_digest verbatim; lower-case start, no period.

cli.sessions_move_workset.help_without.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm

cli.sessions_move_workset.help_yes.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm

cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.contend.note: no final period; keep 'Git LFS', 'git submodules' as technical terms.

cli.sessions_move_workset.probe_cannot_f.role: CLI/TUI move confirmation, indented under one worktree row
cli.sessions_move_workset.probe_cannot_f.note: {device} destination device name, {remote} a git remote URL; both verbatim. 'its own access' = the destination's own credentials (SSH key, login), not the source's. Warning only.

cli.sessions_move_workset.probe_cannot_p.role: CLI/TUI move confirmation, indented under one worktree row
cli.sessions_move_workset.probe_cannot_p.note: {device} device name, {remote} git remote URL, verbatim. 'push' is the git verb; keep it as the locale's usual git term.

cli.sessions_move_workset.probe_cannot_c.role: CLI/TUI move confirmation, indented under one worktree row
cli.sessions_move_workset.probe_cannot_c.note: {device} device name, {remote} git remote URL, verbatim. Two causes: the remote address is of a kind lop refuses to try (local path, unusual transport), or git is not installed on the destination.

cli.sessions_move_workset.probe_https_re.role: CLI/TUI move confirmation, indented under one worktree row
cli.sessions_move_workset.probe_https_re.note: {device} device name; {url} an https:// URL the destination could use instead of the SSH remote; verbatim. Only an offer: nothing is changed now.

cli.sessions_move_workset.probe_remedy.role: CLI/TUI move confirmation, indented under one worktree row
cli.sessions_move_workset.probe_remedy.note: {command} is a lop command (e.g. `lop network credential github include owner/repo`), verbatim, never translated. 'the device that lends GitHub access' = the mesh device whose GitHub login is shared with others.

cli.sessions_move_workset.probe_unknown.role: CLI/TUI move confirmation, one line for the whole manifest
cli.sessions_move_workset.probe_unknown.note: {device} device name, verbatim. Not an error: the destination could not be asked (older version or not reachable). 'lop' is the product name.

cli.sessions_move_workset.prereq_missing.role: CLI/TUI move confirmation, one line for the whole manifest; warning only
cli.sessions_move_workset.prereq_missing.note: {device} device name; {tools} a comma-separated list of program names (go, pnpm, node, uv, cargo, npm), verbatim. Must say the move is not blocked.

cli.sessions_move_workset.prereq_team_br.role: CLI/TUI move confirmation, one line; warning only
cli.sessions_move_workset.prereq_team_br.note: {device} device name, verbatim. 'Team Bridge' is a product feature name, keep in English. Must say the move is not blocked.

cli.sessions_move_workset.help_no_engage.role: argparse help for --no-engage-on-arrival on `lop sessions move`
cli.sessions_move_workset.help_no_engage.note: lower-case start, no final period (argparse style). 'active conversation' = one the user or a subagent was using in the last few minutes or that was queued to move.

cli.sessions_move_workset.receipt_resume.role: CLI receipt line after a successful move
cli.sessions_move_workset.receipt_resume.note: {device} destination device name, verbatim. The conversation was started on the destination automatically and given one note listing working files that did not come.
